source_review.definition: Maximum absolute determinant of 29-by-29 unrestricted ±1 matrices. Integer Bareiss gives the exact score.
source_review.public_source: Orrick et al. (2003) provide the printed order-29 construction. Brent lists the corresponding conjectured Gram matrix and determinant.
source_review.baseline: The published human witness has exact determinant magnitude 320*7^12*2^28 = 1188957517256767569920.
source_review.independent_method: The witness dimensions and entries were checked. Its determinant was independently recomputed exactly. Forged score declarations are ignored and illegal entries are rejected.
source_review.scope: The selected configuration is n=29. The result is a feasible lower bound; global optimality is not proved.
